title: acmispon wrangelianus
intro: Acmispon wrangelianus, commonly known as Wrangel Island lotus or Wrangel Island trefoil, is a flowering plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Acmispon wrangelianus may include immune system modulation and antimicrobial activity, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
